Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title states the main change: whitespace-only agent options are now saved as empty options. It matches the changeset, which trims agentOptions before parsing YAML in the fleet and org-wide Agents editors.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the template's main sections. It links issue `#59182`, explains the root cause and fix, gives reproduction steps, and describes the added test. It also marks the changes file and automated tests as done and includes the AI section. Some template items are unchecked or unaddressed: manual QA is not done, and the frontend screenshot, GitOps, and other conditional items are not addressed. The AI section also omits the exact model ID format the template requests, since it lists a model name that may not match the environment-reported ID. **Resolution** Optionally, confirm the model ID in the AI section against the value the environment reports. Optionally, complete manual QA or note why it was skipped, and add a before-and-after screenshot if the reviewer requires one for UI changes.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#59182` requires that whitespace-only agent options either behave like an empty editor (submit the empty config, per `#8095`) or show an inline error. The PR takes the first option. In AgentOptionsPage.tsx, the submit check changes from `agentOptions` to `agentOptions?.trim()`. Whitespace-only input now falls through to `EMPTY_AGENT_OPTIONS` and is not sent to `yaml.load`. The PR also applies the same change to the org-wide Agents card (Agents.tsx), which the issue names as having the same save logic. The PR adds a test, 'submits whitespace-only agent options as an empty config', in AgentOptionsPage.tests.tsx. The test is described in the PR and in the raw summary, but I did not read the test diff. Non-whitespace invalid inputs (for example, `hello` or a YAML list) are listed in the issue as related. They are not part of the stated whitespace-only requirement, and this PR does not change them. The Agents.tsx diff could not be read because its changed blobs are missing from the checkout. Its status rests on the raw summary (+1/-1, same pattern), which is consistent with the PR description.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changed files relate to the issue. The source change in AgentOptionsPage.tsx is the direct fix. The Agents.tsx change applies the same fix to the org-wide save path that the issue describes. The test file covers the new behavior. The changelog file under changes/ is the required changes entry for a user-visible fix. No unrelated changes appear in the summary or in the diff that was read. The Agents.tsx diff was not directly readable, so its scope rests on the raw summary.
